item.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
item.description: As the fast-moving outbreak continues to spread in eastern Congo, fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting efforts to contain the spread of the disease.

item.title: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
item.description: Leader Kim Jong Un reportedly visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons to cope with threats from the U.S. and South Korea.

item.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
item.description: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

item.title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
item.description: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

item.title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
item.description: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

item.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
item.description: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.

item.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
item.description: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.

item.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
item.description: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".

item.title: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers after the QB rips coach Mike McCarthy on TV
item.description: The move capped a chaotic 18 hours in which the team announced it was benching the 42-year-old future Hall of Famer for backup Mason Rudolph ahead of Friday's visit from Denver.
